name: Nocturnal-Stele

civilization.name: The Ossuarine Choirs
civilization.notes: Descendants of a crashed generation ship, their iron-age rites center the hull that never flew again.

description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a tidally locked hemisphere, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
Standing still, you feel the cold air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. Their beacons answer incoming ships in a hundred borrowed languages.
Debris from the escape pod debris field rings the crash basin in a perfect fan, which ballistics cannot explain. Survivors' accounts disagree about the last hour completely.
Wreck-divers talk about the site in lowered voices, and salvage guilds post hazard bonuses that only grow.
